evidence: Directly modifies src/kernel/ headers and bitcoinkernel.cpp, refactoring the kernel logging API and eliminating global logger dependencies.
rationale: Removes global logger dependencies from kernel code to allow consumers to route log streams independently. The kernel logging API was 'too complicated and too restrictive', and decoupling core objects like BlockManager and ChainstateManager from global state is core architectural work for libbitcoinkernel.
